name: Kei MOon (Lite version)
description: Keimoon mod to destroy the Evils (harder version)
author: keimoon

config.name: Unique Quality Factor
config.description: Higher = more unique items. Applied to treasure classes that have a Unique value. Vanilla is 800.

config.name: Set Quality Factor
config.description: Higher = more set items. Applied to treasure classes that have a Set value. Vanilla is 800.

config.name: Rare Quality Factor
config.description: Higher = more rare items. Applied to treasure classes that have a Rare value. Vanilla is 800.

config.name: Magic Quality Factor
config.description: Higher = more magic items. Applied to treasure classes that have a Magic value. Vanilla is 1024.

config.name: Equipment Tier Scaling
config.description: Divides the cascade-to-lower-tier probability for equipment treasure classes. Higher values = more high-level items from high-level areas. 1 = vanilla.

config.name: Rune Tier Stay Chance (%)
config.description: Chance of dropping a rune from the current tier instead of cascading to lower tiers. Applies equally to all tiers. Vanilla is roughly 0.1%-71% depending on tier.

config.name: NoDrop Player Count (Normal)
config.description: Simulates /players N for NoDrop on most TCs. 1=vanilla, 0=guaranteed. Excludes worldstone shard and sunder charm TCs.

config.name: NoDrop Player Count (Worldstone Shards)
config.description: Simulates /players N for NoDrop on the 5 Terrorize Act Consumable Desecrated TCs. 1=vanilla (NoDrop=6000), 0=guaranteed.

config.name: NoDrop Player Count (Sunder Charms)
config.description: Simulates /players N for NoDrop on the Sunder Charms TC. 1=vanilla (NoDrop=23899), 0=guaranteed.
